given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner completes a physical handover
given_when_then.when: The system detects that the Delivery Partner has not generated local evidence for the Delivery Assignment
given_when_then.then: The system automatically retrieves delivery proof from an external courier API

given_when_then.given: The external courier API returns a valid delivery confirmation
given_when_then.when: The system processes the retrieved delivery proof
given_when_then.then: The system treats the proof with the same verification standards as locally captured proof

given_when_then.given: The retrieved delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket

given_when_then.given: The associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to retrieve delivery proof from the external courier API
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the delivery proof

success_criteria: The system successfully retrieves delivery proof from the external courier API when no local evidence is generated by the Delivery Partner.
The system validates the externally retrieved proof using the same standards as locally captured proof.
The system blocks fund release to the Store Partner if the retrieved proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature.
The system prevents the use of delivery proof when the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.
